Common Questions

Frequently Asked

What finance options are available for vehicle loans?

A personal unsecured loan may suit borrowers who prefer not to provide an asset as security. A secured car loan uses the vehicle as security with terms up to 84 months. A chattel mortgage allows business buyers to take ownership while the lender holds security. A novated lease allows finance and eligible running costs to be managed through pre-tax salary.

Can I get finance for a used vehicle or private sale?

Yes — we can help finance vehicles bought from private sellers, dealerships, or auctions. We'll also assist with PPSR checks and ownership verification.

What is a low doc loan?

Low doc vehicle loans are available to business owners and self-employed applicants who may not have traditional income documentation. Lending criteria vary between providers and alternative verification methods may be accepted. All applications are subject to lender approval and eligibility requirements.
